                '[$, ]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered,
        try_cast(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                    'USD', '', 'g'
                ),
                '[$, ]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offer_unit,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') AS prevailing_unit,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
annualized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        offered * CASE offer_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
        prevailing * CASE prevailing_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw
    FROM wage
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        headct,
        0.7 * (
            100 * least(greatest((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
        ) + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
        END AS cwas
    FROM annualized
    WHERE homefirm = 'INFOSYS LIMITED'
      AND start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND start_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT CAST(round(sum(cwas * headct) / sum(headct), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS ewas
FROM scores;

WITH case_scores AS (

    strftime(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS start_month,

      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
),
scored AS (

    start_month,
    headct,
    0.7 * (
      100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
    ) + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
      WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
      ELSE 50
    END AS cwas
  FROM case_scores
)
SELECT
  start_month AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(cwas * headct) / SUM(headct), 2) AS score
FROM scored
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month;

        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

    SELECT o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
           substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month,
           COUNT(*) AS cmrc
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
base AS (
    SELECT r.casenum,
           o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
           r.revdate,
           r.return_channel,
           c.seg_category,
           p.itemcategory,
           (r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
           (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
           CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS unit_value,
           m.cmrc
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    JOIN cmrc m
      ON m.customer_id = o.buyerlink
     AND m.return_month = substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT b.casenum,
           cr.rule_id,
           cr.flat_charge,
           cr.charge_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY b.casenum
               ORDER BY (
                   CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                   CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                   CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                   CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                   CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                   CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                          OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               ) DESC,
               cr.rule_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM base b
    JOIN return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT casenum, rule_id, flat_charge, charge_pct
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
),
charged AS (
    SELECT b.customer_id,
           b.revdate,
           CASE WHEN ch.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ch.flat_charge END +
           (CASE WHEN ch.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE ch.charge_pct END)
               / 100.0 * b.unit_value AS rhc
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN chosen ch ON ch.casenum = b.casenum
)
SELECT customer_id,
       ROUND(SUM(rhc), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM charged
WHERE substr(revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-02'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(rhc) DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;

      + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
target_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        cm.return_month,
        cm.monthly_return_count,
        c.seg_category AS customer_segment,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory AS item_category,
        r.return_details ->> '$.reasoning.primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        qa.assessment_summary ->> '$.condition.item_condition' AS item_condition,
        p.unit_value
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN customer_month_counts cm
      ON cm.customer_id = o.buyerlink
     AND cm.return_month = substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00016'
      AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        t.casenum,
        t.return_month,
        t.unit_value,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + CASE
            WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
              OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END AS specificity
    FROM target_returns t
    JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = t.customer_segment)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = t.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = t.item_category)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = t.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = t.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR t.monthly_return_count >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR t.monthly_return_count <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
),
per_return AS (
    SELECT
        t.return_month,
        t.casenum,
        t.unit_value,

    FROM target_returns t

     AND ch.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    return_month,
    round(sum(flat_charge + charge_pct / 100.0 * unit_value), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM per_return
GROUP BY return_month

    SELECT
        strftime(pr.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month,
        coalesce(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS manufacturer_group,
        count(*) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pr.snapts,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        CASE
            WHEN v.monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN v.monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN v.monthly_volume >= 4 THEN 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier,
        coalesce(om.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN manufacturer_month_volume v
      ON v.snapshot_month = strftime(pr.snapts, '%Y-%m')
     AND v.manufacturer_group = coalesce(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted')
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        s.snapts,
        s.replcost,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                ((r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                 + (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                 + (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                 + (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                 + (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                 + (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM snapshots s
    LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
settlements AS (
    SELECT
        rule_id,
        CASE
            WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 + 0.05 * replcost
            ELSE fixed_fee_usd + (cover_pct / 100.0) * replcost
        END AS settlement_amount
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rule_rank = 1
      AND snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT round(
    100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN settlement_amount ELSE 0 END)
    / nullif(sum(settlement_amount), 0),
    2
) AS standard_share_pct
FROM settlements;

  LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM snap
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    w.rule_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.snapkey
      ORDER BY
        (
          CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) DESC,
        w.rule_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM tiered t
  JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
    ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
   AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)

   AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
   AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
   AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
settled AS (
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    t.snapts,
    t.replcost,
    g.rule_id,
    COALESCE(w.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS fee,

)

) AS standard_share_pct

The query calculates monthly manufacturer claim tiers, selects the most specific matching settlement rule (breaking ties by lowest `rule_id`), and uses the standard terms when no rule matches.

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS snap_month,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        om.replcost,
        count(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', pr.snapts), pm.makertag
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshots
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        s.replcost,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        (
            CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM tiered s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM matches
    WHERE rule_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    s.vol_tier,
    count(*) AS snapshots,
    round(
        avg(
            CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 ELSE g.fixed_fee_usd END
            + (CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.00 ELSE g.cover_pct END / 100.0)
              * coalesce(s.replcost, 0.0)
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM tiered s
LEFT JOIN governing g ON g.snapkey = s.snapkey
WHERE s.vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY s.vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE s.vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 WHEN 'Single' THEN 2 END;
```

    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        s.replcost,

        r.fixed_fee_usd,

        (
            CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

          + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

),

```sql
WITH monthly AS (

    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,

      (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
               * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100), 0)

      / NULLIF(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
               * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100), 0)

  FROM main.plant_record r
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_energy AS (
    SELECT
        m.pnlkind,
        strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
```
```sql
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
```
```sql
            / NULLIF(
```
```sql
                ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
                * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
                0
```
```sql
            ) AS potential_yield,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
            / NULLIF(
                ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
                * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
                0
            )
            - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
            AS recoverable_energy
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        month,
        SUM(recoverable_energy) AS recoverable_energy,
        100 * SUM(recoverable_energy) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_yield), 0) AS loss_ratio
    FROM snapshot_energy
    GROUP BY pnlkind, month
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100 * SUM(CASE WHEN loss_ratio >= 14 THEN recoverable_energy ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_energy), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM technology_months;
```

```sql
        try_cast(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND pr.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01 00:00:00'
),
yields AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh
    FROM raw
),
losses AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        potential_kwh - energy_kwh AS loss_kwh
    FROM yields
    WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
      AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
      AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
),
tech_month AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        100.0 * sum(loss_kwh) / sum(potential_kwh) AS loss_ratio
    FROM losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
),
banded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN loss_ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN loss_ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
            ELSE 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM tech_month
)
SELECT
    b.loss_band,
    count(*) AS snapshots,
    round(avg(l.loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM losses l
JOIN banded b USING (pnlkind, snap_month)
WHERE b.loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY b.loss_band
ORDER BY b.loss_band;
```

```sql
           ELSE '15+'
         END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2

  JOIN (
    SELECT homefirm,
           date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
           COUNT(*) AS emcv
    FROM main.cases
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) v ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))

  SELECT ca.filekey,
         r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
         COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours

       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,

)
```
